```{r load_libraries}
library(terra)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(uwot)

map_dir   <- "C:/git/Perry_surface_analysis/code/best_boot_maps"
methods   <- c("RF","OK","RK")
datasets  <- c("SP","C")
nutrients <- c("ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n","p_h_2")

# -----------------------------
# Index map files
# -----------------------------
map_index <- tibble(
  path = list.files(map_dir, pattern="\\.tif$", full.names=TRUE),
  file = basename(path)
) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset  = str_match(file, "^(SP|C)_")[,2],
    method   = str_match(file, "_(RF|OK|RK)_bestboot\\.tif$")[,2],
    nutrient = str_match(file, "^(SP|C)_(.*)_(RF|OK|RK)_bestboot\\.tif$")[,3]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dataset), !is.na(method), !is.na(nutrient),
         dataset %in% datasets, method %in% methods, nutrient %in% nutrients)

# -----------------------------
# Load nutrient stack for one dataset+method
# -----------------------------
load_feature_stack <- function(map_index, dataset_keep, method_keep, nutrients){
  rows <- map_index %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_keep, method == method_keep, nutrient %in% nutrients) %>%
    arrange(match(nutrient, nutrients))

  if(nrow(rows) != length(nutrients)){
    missing <- setdiff(nutrients, rows$nutrient)
    stop("Missing rasters for ", dataset_keep, " ", method_keep, ": ",
         paste(missing, collapse=", "))
  }

  s <- rast(rows$path)
  names(s) <- rows$nutrient

  # enforce identical geometry (safe)
  s <- resample(s, s[[1]], method="bilinear")
  s
}

# -----------------------------
# Fit UMAP+Kmeans on sample, assign zones to ALL pixels
# (NO dplyr::select used)
# -----------------------------
fit_umap_clusters <- function(feature_stack,
                              n_zones = 4,
                              sample_n = 40000,
                              seed = 1,
                              umap_n_neighbors = 30,
                              umap_min_dist = 0.05){

  set.seed(seed)

  df <- terra::as.data.frame(feature_stack, cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

  # base-subset to predictors
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(df), "cell")
  Xdf <- df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE]

  keep <- complete.cases(Xdf)
  df   <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  Xdf  <- Xdf[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  X  <- as.matrix(Xdf)
  Xs <- scale(X)

  n_use <- min(sample_n, nrow(Xs))
  idx   <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Xs)), n_use)
  Xs_samp <- Xs[idx, , drop = FALSE]

  # learn UMAP on sample
  umap_model <- uwot::umap(
    Xs_samp,
    n_neighbors = umap_n_neighbors,
    min_dist = umap_min_dist,
    n_components = 2,
    metric = "euclidean",
    ret_model = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  # transform ALL pixels using fitted model
  emb_all <- uwot::umap_transform(Xs, umap_model)

  # kmeans in UMAP space
  km <- kmeans(emb_all, centers = n_zones, nstart = 20)

  list(
    cells   = df$cell,
    cluster = km$cluster,
    umap    = emb_all,
    km      = km
  )
}

make_zone_raster <- function(template_raster, fit_obj){
  z <- template_raster
  vals <- rep(NA_integer_, terra::ncell(z))
  vals[fit_obj$cells] <- fit_obj$cluster
  terra::values(z) <- vals
  z <- terra::as.factor(z)
  levels(z) <- data.frame(value = sort(unique(na.omit(fit_obj$cluster))),
                          zone  = paste0("Zone ", sort(unique(na.omit(fit_obj$cluster)))))
  z
}

# -----------------------------
# Run ALL dataset × method combos
# -----------------------------
zones_all <- list()

for(ds in datasets){
  for(m in methods){
    cat("\n--- Fitting zones:", ds, m, "---\n")
    s   <- load_feature_stack(map_index, ds, m, nutrients)
    fit <- fit_umap_clusters(s, n_zones = 4, sample_n = 40000, seed = 7)
    z   <- make_zone_raster(s[[1]], fit)

    key <- paste(ds, m, sep = "_")
    zones_all[[key]] <- z
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# Quick plot (6 panels)
# -----------------------------
op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(2,3), mar = c(2,2,3,5))
for(nm in names(zones_all)){
  plot(zones_all[[nm]], main = nm, axes = FALSE)
}
par(op)

# zones_all now holds 6 management-zone rasters (SP_RF, SP_OK, SP_RK, C_RF, C_OK, C_RK)

```
```{r}
#validation:

# -----------------------------
# 0) Inputs you already have
# -----------------------------
map_dir <- "C:/git/Perry_surface_analysis/code/best_boot_maps"
methods <- c("RF","RK")  # add "OK" later if you want
dataset_keep <- "SP"

# validation data you already fixed earlier (x/y are EPSG:3857)
validation_data <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/perry_fp_Ap_0_20_with_coords.csv") %>%
  mutate(x = as.numeric(x), y = as.numeric(y))

# use ANY raster just to get CRS (your maps are EPSG:26917)
r_template <- terra::rast(file.path(map_dir, "SP_c_RF_bestboot.tif"))

validation_sf_fix <- st_as_sf(validation_data, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 3857, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(terra::crs(r_template, proj = TRUE))  # -> EPSG:26917

val_v <- terra::vect(validation_sf_fix)  # SpatVector for terra::extract

# -----------------------------
# 1) P breaks (ppm) — Coastal Plain thresholds converted from lbs/ac
#    (use your same settings!)
# -----------------------------
depth_cm <- 15
bd_gcm3  <- 1.33

ppm_to_lbsac_factor <- function(depth_cm, bulk_density_gcm3 = 1.33){
  area_m2 <- 4046.8564224
  depth_m <- depth_cm / 100
  bd_kgm3 <- bulk_density_gcm3 * 1000
  soil_mass_kg <- area_m2 * depth_m * bd_kgm3
  (soil_mass_kg * 2.2046226218) / 1e6
}

lbs_per_ppm <- ppm_to_lbsac_factor(depth_cm, bd_gcm3)

p_lbs_breaks <- c(0, 30, 60, 100, Inf)
p_ppm_breaks <- p_lbs_breaks
p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] <- p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] / lbs_per_ppm

# function: bin numeric ppm into 1..4
bin_p <- function(x_ppm, breaks_ppm){
  cut(
    x_ppm,
    breaks = c(-Inf, breaks_ppm[2], breaks_ppm[3], breaks_ppm[4], Inf),
    labels = 1:4,
    right = TRUE,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ) %>% as.integer()
}

zone_labels <- c("Low","Medium","High","Very High")

# observed P bin from validation
stopifnot("p" %in% names(validation_sf_fix))
obs_p_ppm <- as.numeric(validation_sf_fix$p)
obs_bin   <- bin_p(obs_p_ppm, p_ppm_breaks)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Extract predicted zones from zone rasters (RF/RK)
#    IMPORTANT: always use terra::extract()
# -----------------------------
get_pred_bin_from_raw_map <- function(method){
  f <- file.path(map_dir, sprintf("%s_p_%s_bestboot.tif", dataset_keep, method))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
  r <- terra::rast(f)

  # extract predicted P at validation points
  ex <- terra::extract(r, val_v)   # data.frame with ID + layer
  pred_p <- as.numeric(ex[[2]])

  pred_bin <- bin_p(pred_p, p_ppm_breaks)
  tibble(
    method = method,
    observed_ppm = obs_p_ppm,
    predicted_ppm = pred_p,
    obs_bin = obs_bin,
    pred_bin = pred_bin
  )
}

val_bins <- bind_rows(lapply(methods, get_pred_bin_from_raw_map)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(obs_bin), is.finite(pred_bin))

# -----------------------------
# 3) Overall accuracy + within-1-bin
# -----------------------------
zone_acc <- val_bins %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    accuracy = mean(pred_bin == obs_bin),
    pct_accuracy = 100 * accuracy,
    pct_within_1_bin = 100 * mean(abs(pred_bin - obs_bin) <= 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(zone_acc)

# "confusion" style counts
zone_counts <- val_bins %>%
  mutate(
    obs_label  = factor(zone_labels[obs_bin], levels = zone_labels),
    pred_label = factor(zone_labels[pred_bin], levels = zone_labels)
  ) %>%
  count(method, obs_label, pred_label) %>%
  arrange(method, obs_label, pred_label)

print(zone_counts)

```
